info.description: Init — PolyBLEP into Output (same as patches/init.json)
info.name: Init

volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

octave.tooltip: Shared octave offset into Voice Frequency.

semitones.tooltip: Shared semitone offset into Voice Frequency.

cents.tooltip: Shared cents offset into Voice Frequency.

frequency.tooltip: Shared Hz offset after octave/semitone/cents (param domain).

voices.tooltip: Number of PolyBLEP oscillators (max 64). Decimal like Additive: 12.5 → 13 oscillators with the last at half amplitude.

centerSide.tooltip: 0 = center voices only, 1 = side voices only. Face: additive off-red=left, off-blue=right, center=both→white.

waveform.tooltip: soemdsp PolyBLEP shape for every oscillator. Pulse / Pulse Center / Trisaw use Morph as PWM.

morph.tooltip: PWM / width (0…1). 0.5 = center / 50%. Affects Trisaw, Pulse, and Pulse Center. Same bipolar rational −0.9 skew as PolyBLEP Morph (finer near center).

frequency.tooltip: Shared fundamental for every oscillator. 0 Hz is valid (frozen phase). Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency. Domain is param-owned — DSP does not floor Hz.

phase.tooltip: Global phase add on every voice (cycles). Also slides the face phase lines.

phaseCollapse.tooltip: Where Distance 0 settles. Merge (0): all phases stack together. Distribute (1): walk collapses onto even centers (i/N).

randomizePhase.tooltip: Permanent random starting phase offset per saw (after Distance). 0 = no extra random offset.

jitterDistance.tooltip: Walk room around phase centers. 0 = collapse onto centers (Merge or Distribute). Uses normal parameter smoothing (param menu).

vibratoDistance.tooltip: Sine phase room around centers — same units as Jitter Distance. (1/N)×Distance × Modulation Tilt × wavetable sine. Speed is constant Hz.

jitterSpeed.tooltip: Walk step rate when Distance > 0. Pitch-tilted with Modulation Tilt.

vibratoSpeed.tooltip: Sine LFO rate in Hz. Not pitch-tilted — Modulation Tilt hits Distance, not this.

jitterSteps.tooltip: Fixed: drunk ±step (original Hypersaw). Random: noise×step (noisier grain).

jitterFilter.tooltip: Walk LPF cutoff in Hz. Same at every pitch. Low = smooth. High = rawer steps.

jitterDistanceTiltSource.tooltip: Wavelength: higher pitches move more so phase travel matches. Division: allotted 1/N slot space (legacy).

vibratoDistanceTiltSource.tooltip: Wavelength: higher pitches move more so phase travel matches. Division: allotted 1/N slot space.

vibratoPhaseVary.tooltip: Per-voice sine start phase (Master Seed). 0 = all in phase; 1 = full random 0…1 offset.

seed.tooltip: Master seed for Random Phase and per-voice Random Steps jitter.

recalculateOnTrigger.tooltip: On = latch Attack/Decay/Amplitude on rising Trigger. Off = knobs always live. Rising Trigger never resets the envelope level.

attack.tooltip: One-pole rise toward Trigger/Gate from the current level (no snap-reset). 0 = instant.

decay.tooltip: Fall length (Thump-style). 0 = short, 0.5 = default, 1 = long. Exp feedback into fall rate (pluck envelope 1).

mode.tooltip: Real-pole stacks. LP / HP use LPF / HPF. BP is HP then LP. ƒ sets the active cutoff (BP moves both).

slope.tooltip: Cascaded real 1-poles. 6 dB = one pole; 24 dB = four. No resonance.

stagger.tooltip: Pole spread ratio k. 1 = same freq; ~1.5 gentle spread; above ~2.2 a stair-step. No effect at 6 dB.

lowFrequency.tooltip: Highpass cutoff (HP and BP). Sweep / ƒ / 0.1V move cuts together. When ƒ is wired in HP, that Hz is the cutoff.

highFrequency.tooltip: Lowpass cutoff (LP and BP). Sweep / ƒ / 0.1V move cuts together. When ƒ is wired in LP, that Hz is the cutoff.

sweep.tooltip: Shift used cutoffs in semitones. BP keeps the HPF/LPF interval (ratio) constant.

gainCompensation.tooltip: On = scale poles so the labeled cutoff is −3 dB. Off = every pole sits on the staggered freqs. No effect at 6 dB.

mode.tooltip: Lin = clamp Env to 0…1. Exp = classic VCA CV law (quiet lows, unity at 1) for Amplitude params.
Pattern: up, dn, up/dn, dn/up, or random over Arp Keys.

rate.tooltip: Free-run step rate when Trigger and f are unconnected. Ignored whenever f is patched (external rate in Hz). Trigger edges always win over both.

steps.tooltip: Steps before pattern restart (esp. Random). 0 = natural wrap / free-run RNG.

seed.tooltip: RNG seed for Random. Reset re-seeds from this value.

octaveOffset.tooltip: Transpose arpeggiated pitch by whole octaves (−4…+4). Applied to 0.1V/Oct and ƒ outs.

sequenceOffset.tooltip: Rotate the pattern (including Random) by this many steps. Same seed, different offset → a shifted sequence.

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides.

bpm.tooltip: Tempo in beats per minute. Also writes the patch Master Clock BPM.

pulseWidth.tooltip: Gate high duty of each cycle (0..1). 0.5 = square. Affects Gate 0-1 / Gate -1+1.

timeNumerator.tooltip: Numerator of Numer/Denom × whole note, locked to master playhead. Numer=0 → no clock. 1/4 = one beat at BPM.

timeDenominator.tooltip: Denominator of Numer/Denom × whole note. At Numer=1: Denom 4=¼, 8=⅛, 16=1/16, 32=1/32.

timingMode.tooltip: Normal = Numer/Denom as written. Dotted = 1.5×. Triplet = 2/3×. Always re-grids onto master time — never free-runs.

amplitude.tooltip: Output level for gate and trigger outs.

volume1.tooltip: Pair 1 level (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity.

volume2.tooltip: Pair 2 level (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity.

pan1.tooltip: Pair 1 stereo balance. 0 = unchanged. −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

pan2.tooltip: Pair 2 stereo balance. 0 = unchanged. −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

amplitude.tooltip: Master gain after both pairs (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity.

mode.tooltip: ZDF state-variable EQ (Robin Schmidt / RS-MET). 2-pole modes use compact labels (HP12, LP12, …). Order: Bypass, HP12, LP12, then the rest. Min-phase, zero latency.

frequency.tooltip: Cutoff / center in Hz. When ƒ is wired, that Hz is absolute. Unwired uses this knob, tracked by 0.1V/Oct. 0 allowed (frozen).

q.tooltip: Resonance / bandwidth. ~0.707 is Butterworth-like for LP/HP.

gain.tooltip: Used by Peak, LS12, and HS12 modes.

frequency.tooltip: Oscillator frequency in Hz. Domain-add MOD on Frequency (set base 0 for absolute Hz sources). Recursive free-running sine (RS-MET).

phase.tooltip: Phase used when Reset is triggered (or on first sample).

smoothingSeconds.tooltip: Time the output takes to reach the mouse target. 0 = snap.

smoothingType.tooltip: Lin = constant-time ramp. 1P / 2P = exponential. Papoulis = 3rd-order settle.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = target the pointer set. Smoothed = actual output chasing that target.

polarity.tooltip: Legacy. Bipolar with Min at 0 maps Bias to −Max…+Max.
